title: feat(app-shell): fold the .custom pair's landing card under its base and name the base on the pending-changes sheet
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbUbQXNJDPax1UE5upP9BnZj)_

Part of #29691

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 首页「我的软件包」不再给 `BASE.custom` 定制包单独一张卡,它折叠在基座卡下(与软件包切换器同一规则);基座卡保留「已定制 n 项」及其链接。待发布变更面板在审阅定制包草稿时,标题下多一句「保存到 基座名 的定制」。
- 为什么改:定制一个只读软件包后,首页冒出一张用户从没建过的「可写」包卡,而面板只说「本软件包」,用户不知道改动存到了哪里(ADR-0146 D3)。
- 风险与回滚:仅 UI 与一条新文案键;定制包的导出与删除仍在 Studio「概览 → 软件包」页(已实测)。回滚即还原本 PR,无数据或协议变化。
- 先看:`BuilderLanding.tsx` 的折叠(`foldCustomizationPairs`);`DraftChangesPanel.tsx` 的 `customizationOf` 一行;`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 只在 `pairId` 存在时传入基座名。
- 两分钟验证:在 showcase 定制任意一项后打开 `/_console/studio`,「我的软件包」里不再有 `com.example.showcase.custom` 卡,只读区的 Showcase 卡写着「已定制 1 项」;点 Publish 打开面板,标题下是「保存到 ObjectStack Showcase 的定制」。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Landing (ADR-0146 D3).** `BuilderLanding` folds each `BASE.custom` pair under its base with the switcher's own `foldCustomizationPairs` before it splits writable from read-only. A pair whose base is listed draws no card in either section. The base's card keeps its "n customized" line, and that line's link into the pair. A pair whose base is not listed keeps its card, the switcher's rule too.
- **Pending-changes sheet.** `DraftChangesPanel` takes an optional `customizationOf` (the base's label) and, when set, says under its title "Saved to BASE's customizations" (zh 保存到 BASE 的定制). The sentence is one exported helper, `savedToCustomizationText`, so the item header can say the same words in the follow-up PR. `StudioDesignSurface` passes the base label only while it reviews a pair's drafts (`pairId` set), and nothing for a writable package or a base with no pair.
- **i18n.** One new key, `preview.changes.savedToCustomization`, in all ten `@object-ui/i18n` locale packs. Nothing is removed or renamed.
- **Not changed:** the publish toast (the card's direction names only the item header and the sheet), and the item header, which waits for #29693 and lands in a second PR.

## Contract review

- **What widens:** the published `@object-ui/i18n` locale packs gain one leaf, `preview.changes.savedToCustomization`, in each of the ten packs, and `@object-ui/app-shell` gains an optional `DraftChangesPanel` prop (`customizationOf`) and one exported helper (`savedToCustomizationText`).
- **What narrows:** nothing. No key, prop, export or accepted value is removed or tightened. Metadata authors see no change (`Metadata-protocol: none`).

## Tests

- `BuilderLanding.customizationCounts-28566.test.tsx`: a new describe over the real landing. A read-only base and its writable pair draw one card, the base's, with its customized count and the pair link, and the pair's name and id appear on no card. A read-only pair folds under its listed base too. CONTROL: a writable package that is no pair keeps its card, and a pair whose base is not listed keeps its card. The existing "no line for a pair" case now finds the orphan pair's card and no card for the folded one.
- `DraftChangesPanel.test.tsx`: a new describe that renders the real sheet through the real i18next hook and the shipped packs. With `customizationOf="HotCRM"` it reads 保存到 HotCRM 的定制 in zh and "Saved to HotCRM’s customizations" in en. CONTROL: without it, no sentence.
- `StudioDesignSurface.customizePublish-28562.test.tsx` (the real surface): reviewing a listed pair, and after the first edit makes the pair, the sheet is handed the base label `HotCRM`. CONTROL: a base with no pair hands it nothing.

## Acceptance notes

- **Where the pair's export and delete live.** They were never on the landing card, which offered only Open and Duplicate. They are on Studio, Overview → Packages (`nav_packages` → `/apps/studio/component/developer/packages`, the `developer:packages` page). That page lists every served package with no pair fold. The pair's row opens a detail sheet with Export (every row, `GET /api/v1/packages/:id/export`) and Delete package (writable rows, `DELETE /api/v1/packages/:id`). Measured live on a fresh showcase (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`, branch head `d47495aa`): `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` answered 201 and created `com.example.showcase.custom`. `GET /api/v1/packages` then served it as its own row (`writable: true`, `source: authored`), the row the Packages page draws. `GET /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase.custom/export` answered 200 with the pair's manifest, and `DELETE /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase.custom` answered 200, after which the list held only `com.example.showcase`. Those are the doors the sheet's Export and Delete package buttons call (`PackagesPage`: Export on every row, Delete package on writable rows); the buttons themselves were read from code, not clicked.
- **The review's claim that the pair card's link returns to the base holds.** The pair card opened `/studio/PAIR/data`, and the `StudioDesignSurface` wrapper sends every pillar URL of a pair to the base's surface. `StudioDesignSurface.oneSurface-28572` already pins that. The base card's customized link takes the same path, unchanged.

## Verification

<details><summary>Tests and gates (final head 62ad4a49; sweep on d47495aa, and the merge of main brought no file under ui/)</summary>

- **Red on main, green here.** The three touched test files with `origin/main` `1c1a5d40`'s `BuilderLanding.tsx`, `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (each blob-identical to main, restored to `HEAD` after, `git diff HEAD` empty): 7 failed, 24 passed. The 7 are the new pins; the CONTROL cases stay green on main. On the branch: Test Files 3 passed, Tests 31 passed, on `d47495aa` and again on `62ad4a49`.
- **Sweep** (`--maxWorkers=2`, locked): every ui test file naming `BuilderLanding` or `DraftChangesPanel` plus every test reading the locale packs or `preview.changes`, 254 files in six batches, all green (346 + 425 + 554 + 289 + 519 + 677 tests), and `packages/i18n/` whole: 95 files, 1443 passed, 13 skipped.
- **Type check:** `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: 66 of 66 tasks green.
- **eslint** on the touched source and test files: 0 errors, 8 warnings. One is react-refresh's only-export-components warning on the new `savedToCustomizationText` export, the warning the file's three other exported helpers already carry. The other 7 are on lines this PR does not touch.
- **Derived gates** (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 35 commands, each exit 0, including `check-sdui-manifest`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-closing-keyword-parity` (run against this body) and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (170 files passed, 2 skipped).
- **Not run locally:** the full Test UI shards, which CI's Test UI runs.

</details>
